paragraphs.text: 一个DSH插件，为自定义模型配置输入类型(input)、推理模式（reasoningEfforts）
# dsh-model-capabilities
A **DeepSeek Harness** plugin that lets you edit each model's **input modalities** (`input: ["text",
"image"]`) and per-model **`reasoningEfforts`** directly from the Settings UI — no hand-editing `se
nd per-model **`reasoningEfforts`** directly from the Settings UI — no hand-editing `settings.yaml`.
It works on **DSH Web** and **DSH Desktop**: Desktop runs the same web bundle in compatibility mode
on the same profile, so no extra registration is needed.
> **How this relates to `WJZ-P/dsh-model-capabilities` (`dsh-model-capability`)**: that plugin adds
a single *input-type* selector into the native Models editor. This package is a **complement, not a

clone** — it adds the two things that plugin (and the built-in Models page) leave out:
>
> * **`reas
oningEfforts`** (per-level reasoning wiring: `minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max` + `off`, with custo

m wire values) — WJZ-P's plugin does not cover reasoning at all.
> * A **whole-profile, batch view**
: it enumerates every configured model under *both* `providers.<route>.models[]` **and** `providers.

<route>.modelOverrides` at once, so you can review and write to all of them from one place.
>
> If y
ou only need the `input: text/image` picker while adding a model, WJZ-P's inline field is the lighte
r choice; if you also need reasoning wiring and a full overview of configured models (incl. override
s), this package is what you want.
## What it adds
A new **Settings** section ("Model Input & Reasoning" / 模型输入与推理) that:
- Lists every configured provider and its models (`providers.<route>.models[]` and `providers.<route

>.modelOverrides`).
- Lets you toggle `input` modalities (`text`, `image`) per model.
- Lets you set

`reasoningEfforts` per model:
- **Non-reasoning** → writes `reasoningEfforts: false`.
- **Reasoning
** → fill a wire value per level (`minimal|low|medium|high|xhigh|max`); `off` may be left empty (sen

d no reasoning parameter). At least one non-`off` level must be filled.
- Writes straight through th
e existing `llm-pi-ai` settings namespace (`settings.mutate`), so the running `llm-pi-ai` adapter re
-registers routes and the model picker shows the new reasoning levels immediately, and the change pe
rsists to `settings.yaml`.
The existing built-in "Models" page intentionally does **not** expose these two per-model fields (re
asoning is a per-model capability); this plugin fills exactly that gap with a dedicated page.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`dsh plugin add` installs the package into the profile (`profiles/<name>/node_modules`), appends it
to `dsh.profile.bundles`, and applies the package's `cordis.patch.yml` (which activates the minimal
host entry that the client-modules node half needs to discover and serve the browser bundle).

Alternatively, for a local mount:
1. Put the built package under `profiles/<name>/node_modules/dsh-m

odel-capabilities/`.
2. Add `"dsh-model-capabilities"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in `profiles/<name>/

package.json`.
3. Restart DSH.

## Build (from source)
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Prerequisites: Node ^22.19 / >=24 and pnpm. `tsdown` must be >= 0.22 (older 0.7.x ships a rolldown t
hat fails to expose `transformPlugin`).
## Requirements & behavior notes
- The section reads/writes the `llm-pi-ai` settings namespace. If no provider/model is configured ye

t (the section would be empty), add one under the built-in **Models** page first.
- Validation mirro
rs the `llm-pi-ai` schema (`MODALITIES = [text, image]`; `THINKING_LEVELS = [off, minimal, low, medi
um, high, xhigh, max]`; `reasoningEfforts` is `false` or a `{level → string|null}` map with only `of
f` allowed empty). Invalid values are rejected client-side, and the host schema re-validates as the

final guard.
- On a read-only connection the page shows a notice and disables saving.
- Write confli
cts (stale revision) are surfaced and the page refreshes for a retry.
